effects.issue: The text targets any two cards you control, but Spell/Trap Cards and many monsters cannot have a Level. Literal resolution is undefined for those legal printed targets; the Lua restricts selection to two face-up monsters with Levels. Resolution: change the target to '2 face-up monsters you control with Levels' (or specify how non-Level cards behave), then align c225106953.lua to that ruling.
